text:
Ellen Park: AtlasGrid sent invoice AG-2026-556 for €9,200 but their PDF lists entity "AtlasGrid EU" and we need it billed to Redwood Inc (USD). No PO on invoice.
Marco D'Souza: Invoice currency mismatch + wrong legal entity is a blocker. Do we have a PO at all?
Ellen Park: No PO number. Our procurement issued PO-9120 in USD to AtlasGrid (US) last quarter. Vendor used EU billing template by mistake.
Tanya Roy: Coupa auto-match failed. APBot: FLAGGED - NO_PO_MATCH and ENTITY_MISMATCH.
APBot: Invoice AG-2026-556 flagged: PAYMENT_HOLD. AP ticket AP-54610 created. Required approvers: Owen Blake (Procurement), Tax team (for VAT handling).
Owen Blake: Procurement confirms PO-9120 exists and should apply. We need vendor to reissue to Redwood Inc with USD totals or AP must do FX/IC adjustments. I can approve a one-off intercompany re-charge but need tax clearance.
TaxBot: VAT risk: vendor invoicing EU entity may create VAT reclaim complexity. Tax team must review before override. Tagging @Tanya Roy for documentation.
Tanya Roy: I've uploaded vendor correspondence and screenshots. Proposed GL account 6501 and memo: "intercompany reclass if vendor cannot reissue".
Marco D'Souza: Vendor says they can reissue within 48h but they want payment now. They offered to send a proforma in USD, but legal entity must change.
Ellen Park: Short of reissue, can AP process with PO-9120 and do an intercompany journal? That needs FP&A and Tax sign-off.
Owen Blake: I approve temporary processing to avoid late penalty if Tax signs off. I'll also request vendor to fix billing template permanently.
Tanya Roy: Tax reviewed and approves conditional processing with note: "vendor billed wrong entity; tax to reconcile VAT via IC invoice". Approve AP override.
APBot: Required approvals recorded. PAYMENT_HOLD cleared pending vendor reissue or IC journal. Payment scheduled on 2026-04-05 payment run. Please follow up: vendor must reissue within 7 days.
Ellen Park: I'll confirm schedule with AtlasGrid and ask for corrected invoice referencing PO-9120 and Redwood Inc. Adding action: Procurement to confirm vendor billing contact is updated.
Marco D'Souza: Thanks. Owen, Tanya, please add any required tax docs to AP-54610; I'll close once payment posts and reissue arrives.
